variables_help: Insert %NAME anywhere in an action text. Built-in device variables: %DATE, %TIME, %DATETIME, %BATTERY, %CHARGING, %WIFI, %BLUETOOTH, %RINGER, %SCREEN, %AIRPLANE, %NETWORK, %BRIGHTNESS, %BRAND, %MODEL, %SDK. Unknown names are left as-is.
